blocks.x: Last mile is the costliest mile: route density, delivery promise, failed-delivery economics and urban access rules. Dynamic routing, fleet telemetry and micro-hub orchestration decide whether the final mile makes money. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in dynamic routing, delivery promise management, failed-delivery recovery, with micro-hub operations close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
The queues and waits that come up first, Last-Mile & Urban Logistics edition:

items: Dynamic multi-stop routing exceeds solver time budgets.
Delivery windows missed; WISMO calls climb.
Vehicle/parcel telemetry sparse; failed deliveries unexplained.
Address issues and redeliveries by call center.
EV fleet charging/range planning by spreadsheet.

blocks.x: The proof in Last-Mile & Urban Logistics is a working system on a real workflow. These are the builds that go live:

items: ETA models per stop with confidence
address/availability issues remediated via customer channels
